key_points: Cloudflare rethinks identity in the age of AI agents — identities aren't just people but agents, scripts, and third-party tools acting on your behalf
Three core pillars: Principal (who), Credential (token/passport), Policy (visa/RBAC) must be managed together

Resource-scoped permissions GA: Access Applications, Identity Providers, Policies, Service Tokens, Targets — true least-privilege
New RBAC roles at account level (CDN, MCP Portals, Radar, Request Tracer, SSL/TLS) and zone level (Analytics, Logpush, Page Rules, Security Center, Snippets, Zone Settings)
AI Gateway DLP integration scans prompts and model responses in real-time for credential leakage

EmpowerID's 6 Laws of AIdentity: split actor, generated intent, bounded agency, authorization as a loop, least exposure, justifiable action

Non-human identities outnumber humans 25-50x across enterprises, with most lacking proper governance
